l.i: Quo se iure putat Dux Gallis iura daturum Mænius, & Valesis sceptra tributa petit?
Cur validas armat per Gallica rura cohortes?
Cur Gallos cogit iam sua iussa sequi?
Huic mater, Veneris recludens furta, parente Regius es, dixit, sanguis utroque puer.
Nunc Regi non est, mihi crede, propinquior alter.
Te male Guisiadem garrula fama vocat.
Aude ergo, ut quondam Macedo, quum matre monente Se genitum Ammonio credidit esse Ioue.

page.notes: The initial Q at the start of the first stanza is a historiated woodcut initial; it is read as "Q" joined to "uo" as "Quo". Line-end hyphens in the poem ("da-", "mo-") are printed hyphens. The first line reads "Vo se" in the scan, interpreted as "Quo se" with the initial. Ornamental headpiece and lower woodcut ornament are not text.
